video_summary.overall_goal: Add a hostname to the whitelist (allowed hosts) in AdAway ad blocker
video_summary.description: User opens AdAway app from home screen, navigates to allowed hosts section, searches for and enters a hostname (edhb and utl.web), and attempts to whitelist it. The workflow involves app launch, navigation to the whitelist feature, hostname search/input, and applying configuration changes.

Red pause button visible at bottom.

Floating action button (red plus) at bottom right. Bottom navigation shows Blocked/Allowed/Redirected tabs.

overall_flow: View main status screen (showing blocked/allowed/redirected counts)
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: User taps AdAway app icon from home screen, app opens and loads main activity
Step 2: User views AdAway main screen showing 80065 blocked ads, 0 allowed, 0 redirected hosts; decides to navigate to whitelist by tapping Allowed section
Step 3: User enters search/whitelist management view where they can search for hostnames; 'yguy' is visible from previous entries
Step 4: User searches for hostname by typing 'edhb' in the search field; appears to trigger error/validation indicator
Step 5: User taps hamburger menu or plus button to open 'Add host to whitelist' dialog, confirming the hostname 'edhb' is added
Step 6: User returns to whitelist view showing new entry 'utl.web' with red checkmark (marked as allowed), and previous entry 'yguy' unchecked
Step 7: User receives notification 'Your configuration changed. You need to apply it.' and taps APPLY button to persist the whitelist changes to the system
